_comment: mulib (external/mulib, see CMakeLists.txt) additionally requires opencascade, spdlog, and cli11, which aren't listed below yet — run `vcpkg add port opencascade spdlog cli11` from this directory once vcpkg is bootstrapped on the build machine to add them (this lets vcpkg validate the port names against the live registry instead of hand-typing them here). Also verify the qtbase 'opengl' feature/port name at that point — mulib requires Qt6::OpenGL and Qt6::OpenGLWidgets which the 'widgets' feature below may not cover.
